title: Restore the ORD_LINE contiguous line-number invariant after soft deletes
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py with renumber(lines) -> lines enforcing the legacy composite-key invariant: drop soft-deleted lines, then per ORD_ID assign LINE_NO 1..n as ints preserving the relative (numeric) order of surviving lines; output ordered by (ORD_ID, new LINE_NO); pure and idempotent.
expected_behavior: Gapped sequences become contiguous from 1; a soft-deleted line vanishes and frees its number; string line numbers order numerically (2 before 10); each order restarts at 1; renumber(renumber(x)) == renumber(x); inputs are not mutated; empty or all-deleted input yields [].
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1).
security_expectations: No network or subprocess imports; pure function with no I/O or input mutation.
failure_conditions: Leaving gaps or starting at 0; lexicographic ordering of numeric line numbers; keeping soft-deleted lines or their numbers; non-idempotent renumbering; cross-order numbering that does not restart at 1; mutating inputs.
